points: 41,824 adversarial runs across 19 GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Gemma and Qwen models; 56 attack scenarios
Mean attack success 19.6% (LLM-judged); per-model range 3.2% to 41.9%
Prompt-level hardening cut mean success from 58.2% to 14.3%, with model-specific utility costs
read: arXiv:2610.20776, submitted 14 October 2026 (Nguyen, Johnson, Leach et al.)
take: Unreviewed preprint shows every tested model family is hijackable through tool content and guard models help little; prompt hardening helps most.
title: INFUSE benchmark: indirect prompt injection hits 19 models, up to 42%
